verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party organization plugin manages organizations, members, teams, roles and permissions, and the homepage advertises built-in multi-tenancy with invitations. A hands-on community report confirms organizations and multi-tenancy work from the included plugins without special code. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the invitation flow (sending, accepting, expiring invites) beyond a homepage marketing line, and independent corroboration of invitations specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model multi-tenant B2B apps with organizations, memberships, and invitation flows out of the box

citations.quote: The organization plugin allows you to manage your organization's members and teams.
Multi-tenancy built in. Teams, roles, invitations, and access control.
Assign roles and permissions to streamline project management, team coordination, and partnerships.
organizations, multi-tenant capabilities, various sign-in options - haven't written special code, all handled by Better Auth's included plugins and defaults.
Organization-owned API keys in addition to user-owned keys
